The '''Evociii swamp''' was a swamp located east of the town of [[Jiguuna]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. The [[Evocii]] village of [[Voam]] was located in the swamp.
